summary: Ansible-maintained resource modules follow uniform patterns; use the resource module builder. Process: propose a model PR, get the builder, scaffold, implement, test, then PR to the right collection.
questions: How do I develop a new network resource module?
What's the process for contributing a resource module?

answer_card.title: Resource module development process
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Propose your resource model as a PR in the resource module models repo.
2. Get the latest resource module builder.
3. Run it to scaffold a collection from the approved model.
4. Implement the module.
5. Write integration and unit tests.
6. Open a PR to the appropriate collection.
